main_text.p: in cap. 15. verf. 10. Sic inqvit Raphelen-gius in variis lectionibus ל ולמא Ven. rectius רשומה pro quo seperatim scribo מה רשי in Ezech. 27. 6. Osea 13. 14 Ju-dic. 5. 16. 1. Sam. 12, 6. & 19. 24. 2. Sam. 17. 2. & in qvamplurimis locis, hac se-paratione dictionum & mutatione li-terarum similium in similes, dolose totam Chaldaicam Paraphrasim vitia-runt impii Rabini; ita ut nullum pene sit testimonium a Christo Domino & ab Apostolis citatum in testamento novo: quod non sit adulteratum detortumque ad captivitatem; nec Prophetia de nata-li, passione, morte, resurrectione Domini, quæ non obcæcarent impietate Rab-binica, atquæ thalmundica fabula everte-rent; sicut præsepe Domini Adonidis si-mulacro, locum crucis Veneris statua, re-surrectionis situm Jovis effigie obscurare conati sunt; sed quis contra Deum! Vir-tus tanta caligine obscurata refulget: ut Lucianus Θεὸς ἀπὸ μηχανῆς ἐπιφανείς. Virtuteque duce, comite fortuna: virtus enim eligit, quod est optimum. Quod si non

page.notes: The Hebrew words "ל ולמא" (line 2) and "מה רשי" (line 4) are hard to read at this scan resolution and may not be exact. The Hebrew "רשומה" (line 3) is clearer. The Greek phrase is set in italic. The page begins mid-paragraph, so the first paragraph continues from the previous page, and the catchword "non" is the first word of the next page.
